scenes.title: 1 · Base scene construction & inspection
scenes.subtitle: 5 base scenes and 7 new rooms, checked in Isaac Sim 5.1 on cloud GPUs.

kpis.label: Isolated fixtures passing L0
kpis.note: OpenBalance, XPR204E, dispenser holder, reference-weight drop, 2 kg combined fix

method: L0 = 60 warm-up steps + 600 quiet physics steps: every object tilts ≤ 0.5° and drifts ≤ 5 mm, zero engine errors, healthy process exit, complete logs.
Diagnostic runs only locate causes; they never grant L0, instrument, readout or robot approval.
Physics: CPU MBP/TGS solver, dt 1/120 s, gravity −9.81 m/s² along Z; scene root in SI units (metres, Z up).

Agent 1 then reviews it as a new fixture variant before anyone runs it.

paper.title: 3 · Papers → protocols → orchestrated tasks
paper.subtitle: Every extracted number is tied to a quoted span of the source text, then compiled into robot, instrument-program and manual steps.

kpis.label: Success criteria with a source tolerance

components.name: Span-verified extraction
components.detail: Agent-drafted values are accepted only when a mechanical verifier finds them in the source text.

components.name: Plan compiler + scheduler
components.detail: Compiles protocols into skill calls and instrument jobs; constraint-solver schedule; board regenerates byte-identically.

components.name: Simulator runtime rule set v3
components.detail: Exact allow-list of the simulator's own runtime edits; anything else blocks a run.

components.name: Independent skill verifier

timeline.text: Simulator runtime rule set v2 active.
Main lab root fixed to SI units (metres, Z up).
OpenBalance and XPR204E balances pass isolated L0.
Balance readout chain works natively: 100 g reads 0.1000 kg.
First interference-free readings for 100 g – 2 kg: means within 0.1 %, still jittery.
Root cause of 'no CUDA device' in GPU jobs found and fixed (GPU id mismatch).
First native robot skill trial passes 4/4.
Balance routine-check protocol + auto scene started.
Independent verifier and first plan-driven execution request.
Five beaker supports and the 2 kg weight fix pass; next blocker found (dispenser).
Verifier and executor agree on all 44 values after aligning the angle definition.
Skill-approval job re-submitted after a launcher fix.
